description: Version bumps for the pins nobody would otherwise refresh: the Python base image digest, the hash-pinned lockfile, the dev and docs requirements, the npm dev tools and the workflow actions.
Renovate opens one pull request per group, weekly, and stops; review, CI and the merge desk take it from there like any other.
minimumReleaseAge is the cool-down: nothing younger than three days is proposed.
osvVulnerabilityAlerts asks for a security update when OSV has an advisory on a pin. It reads main only, so what is released but fixed on main stays the advisory desk's to report.

app/requirements.txt is bumped by the pip_requirements manager, which rewrites a package's hashes with hashin; the CI lockfile drift guard then checks the result still matches requirements.in. A bump that needs a new transitive dependency fails that guard and needs the lockfile regenerated by hand, as its header describes.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Transitive npm packages have no line of their own in package.json, so nothing else moves them, and advisories on them stayed open. pip_requirements has no lock file here for this to touch.

packageRules.description: The forge CI's job containers run the Dockerfile's python image, and the lockfile drift guard relies on it: their digests move together.

A new Python minor (3.14 to 3.15) changes the interpreter the image ships, the CI job containers run and the lockfile resolves against: one pull request of its own for every python image, whichever file names it, never part of a weekly group.

Workflows outside .github run on the forge's runner, which is not GitHub: a newer action major can need a newer node than it has, and upload-artifact past v3 refuses it as an unsupported GHES (see the comment on that step). Digest refreshes only there, and upload-artifact not at all.
Python 3.15 waits for brotli to publish cp315 wheels (the slim image has no compiler to build it), and then comes as its own deliberate pull request, not a Renovate one.
dev/gen and dev/lastfm-mock stay on Python 3.12 until that same pull request moves them; their digests are still pinned and refreshed.
@axe-core/playwright 4.14 declares node >=22.12, and both CI jobs install Debian's node 20: held below it until CI moves to a newer node.
